muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /events htmx(sse(Stream(ctx, send)))" -}}{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

// Server streams to an htmx page via the SSE extension: the htmx framing
// changes only the render type, so events keep the generic data:-line
// framing over the shared transport.
type Server struct{}

func (Server) Stream(_ context.Context, send func(string) error) {
	_ = send("tick")
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/events", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	if ct := rec.Header().Get("Content-Type"); ct != "text/event-stream" {
		t.Errorf("content-type = %q, want text/event-stream", ct)
	}
	if want := "data: tick\n\n"; !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), want) {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want the plain data line %q (no frontend-specific event framing)", rec.Body.String(), want)
	}
}
